text: At the primary setting, mean ECA was 8.3424% for H, 8.1659% for S, and 6.0182% for B. The H-minus-B difference was 2.3242 percentage points. The attribution-preserving decomposition assigned 2.1477 points to S minus B, which isolates removal of client-count division within the same simple procedure, and 0.1765 points to H minus S, which reflects the family decision and selected member. H and S certified the same 177 conditions. A predeclared 20,000-replicate hierarchical bootstrap produced nonnegative H-minus-B point estimates in all ten dataset-condition strata. Descriptive intervals excluded zero in seven strata and touched zero in three. These intervals describe variation within the fixed roster and are neither theorem-confidence intervals nor population-level method tests.
